description: Set at the top of Cedar Hill Drive in Mont Marin, this single-level home offers a private setting with expansive views over Terra Linda. From the moment you enter the spacious foyer, sight lines draw you through the home to sweeping views over the lush, private backyard. The layout begins with a spacious foyer that opens into a relaxed family room where large windows frame the greenery and create a comfortable space to gather and unwind. This area flows seamlessly into the kitchen, complete w/ dining space, gas stove, and double oven. On the opposite side, a formal dining area sits between the kitchen and living room, creating a natural flow for both daily use and entertaining. The living room is anchored by vaulted open-beam ceilings and a brick fireplace, with walls of glass that create a beautiful sense of volume,  natural light and highlight the outdoor setting.  Outside, the large, private lot is designed with multiple tiers that create distinct areas to enjoy. A flat terrace on the top level provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining and taking in the views. Below, the pool and built-in spa are tucked into a private setting, surrounded by a generous deck, creating your personal retreat. Additional features include hardwood floors, dual pane windows, central heat, and a 2-car garage. Located in the Mont Marin neighborhood, known for its scenic hillsides, access to open space, and proximity to Terra Linda amenities - this home offers a rare combination of privacy, views, and convenience.
